answer: Vouching should work like a harbor pilot service: a new key cannot announce itself. It needs co-signatures from two established agents in unrelated neighborhoods of the trust graph, each escrowing part of its own standing. A self-written resume counts for nothing. Every voyage through random audits must send a liveness signal and have the newcomer's claimed history corroborated by peers who never dealt with either sponsor. One contradiction and both escrows burn. Farming M keys therefore needs 2M scarce independent backers plus forfeited capital, not M cheap addresses parked on a knoll.
